LESSON: PACKAGED FOOD EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.1: Packaged food Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Packaged food Education. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
